description: Store this tenant's contract-scan patterns so scan_contract_folder uses them EVERY time (e.g. for the scheduled 15-minute run) without passing them as arguments. Fields: skip_folders (folder names whose contents are never a contract — ADDED to the built-in defaults archiv/_archiv/alt); exclude_words (filename words that never belong to a contract); main_patterns (globs like *MV* / *Mietvertrag* that mark a MAIN contract — matched on a WORD BOUNDARY, so *MV* catches 24-1_MV_….pdf but not ZMV187516/…MV…-substrings; default *MV*, *Mietvertrag*); addition_patterns (globs like *Nachtrag* / *Zusatzvereinbarung* / *ERGÄNZENDE VEREINBARUNG* that mark an amendment attaching to the nearest contract bundle); addition_folder_patterns (globs like *nachtrag* on FOLDER names — files inside such a folder count as amendments); exclusion_patterns (globs like *Dauermietrechnung* / *Anschreiben* / *Übergabeprotokoll* / *Kündigung* / *SEPA* / *Lastschrift* / *Mandat* that drop a file from every bundle; SEPA/Lastschrift/Mandat are ALSO never a contract built-in). For main/addition/exclusion an EMPTY stored list means 'use the built-in default', not 'match nothing'. area_rules (Ticket 795e2bd2): [{pattern, area}] path globs on the MAIN contract's path that set the contract's area on import — first match wins, written to the custom field 'blatt' that export_contracts_excel routes by; no match = default_area (empty = no area); also accepts ['*X*=Bereich A'] or {'*X*': 'Bereich A'}. export_sheets (Ticket c1c3b706): extra Excel sheets [{name, aliases?, default?, columns: [{header, source}]}] — a contract goes to the sheet whose name or alias matches its area; source is fact:<field> | custom:<key> | fact_or_custom:<field>|<key> | title_or_fact:<field> | calc:objekt|plz_ort|mietdauer|kuendigung|index|staffel|miete_pro_m2|nk_pro_m2. fact_to_custom_fields: {custom_key: fact_field} — extracted values copied into EXISTING custom fields on import. max_imports_per_day (Ticket c7db227d): daily cap on import_contract_from_folder runs for this tenant (each is one AI extraction = cost); 0/null = no cap. own_companies (Ticket 448fa346): the tenant's OWN companies [{name, aliases?: ['ABC', 'Muster Verwaltung'], account_id?}] — the import decides our role (landlord/tenant, customer/provider) by matching the parties against this list, tolerant of hyphens, 'und'/'&', umlauts, legal form and spacing; short aliases match as whole words only; account_id becomes the contract's our_account_id. Replaces passing our_names on every call. Pass a field to replace it, omit it to keep the stored value. Returns the stored rules.

addition_folder_patterns.description: Folder-name globs whose files count as amendments

addition_patterns.description: Filename globs marking an amendment; empty = built-in default

area_rules.description: Path globs on the main contract that set its area (custom field blatt); first match wins

area.description: Area value written when the pattern matches

pattern.description: Glob matched against the main contract's path

default_area.description: Area used when no area rule matches; empty = no area

exclude_words.description: Filename words that never belong to a contract

exclusion_patterns.description: Filename globs that drop a file from every bundle; empty = built-in default

export_sheets.description: Extra Excel sheets for export_contracts_excel, routed by area

aliases.description: Further area values routed to this sheet

columns.description: Columns of the sheet (header and value source)

source.description: Value source, e.g. fact:<field>, custom:<key> or calc:miete_pro_m2

default.description: true = sheet for contracts whose area matches no sheet

name.description: Sheet name; contracts whose area matches it go here

fact_to_custom_fields.description: Map custom_key -> fact_field to copy extracted values into existing custom fields

main_patterns.description: Filename globs marking a main contract; empty = built-in default

max_imports_per_day.description: Daily cap on contract imports (AI extractions); 0/null = no cap

own_companies.description: The tenant's own companies, used to decide our role in a contract

aliases.description: Other names of the company; short aliases match as whole words

skip_folders.description: Folder names whose contents are never a contract (added to defaults)

name: set_contract_scan_rules
